title: Introduce compliance deployment shield, operator mapper and ephemeral KMS lease proxy
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Adds a configurable compliance shield for installer deployments: operator RBAC mapping templates, an ephemeral KMS lease proxy to reduce cross-region key exposure, and audit-envelope stamping. Migration steps and rollback included.
description:
Context and motivation: Customers deploying Private (VPC/on-prem) asked for a declarative installer-level control that enforces jurisdictional boundaries, reduces KMS surface area, and creates immutable, minimal audit envelopes without requiring customers to hand-edit manifests. This PR implements a deployable compliance 'shield' that 1) provides operator-scoped RBAC v2 mapping templates applied during install, 2) adds an ephemeral KMS lease proxy that issues short-lived wrapping/unwrap leases scoped to a geozone, and 3) stamps audit envelopes with a compact residency watermark. Migration steps and rollback included.

Merge outcome: PR was squash-merged after final approvals from Connor and Marta; post-merge actions added: automated rollout in Canary 2 for three days, alerting for kms_lease_failures_total > 5/min.
Rollback plan: run installer with --compliance-shield=opt-out then reapply previous operator-mapper manifest; kms leases automatically expire within configured TTL.
Migration notes: when enabling on existing clusters run 'installer migrate-operator-mapper --dry-run' then --apply after verifying idempotency report.
Backward compatibility: default mode is 'opt-in' so no behavior change for current installs.
Security rationale: ephemeral leases reduce standing key exposure and the installer-level RBAC mapping centralizes operator privileges into a policy-reviewed template, reducing per-cluster manual patches.
Operational notes: ephemeral leases default TTL 15m, configurable per geozone.
Known limitations: does not cover hardware key locality validations for air-gapped HSMs (tracked SEC-44).
notes: This PR focuses on Private installer UX and infra glue; runtime integrations with hosted control plane will follow in a follow-up PR. E2E job added to nightly pipeline under 'compliance-shield' tag.
